Afternoon tea
Jun 2024 • Family
We had the afternoon tea set at the Hive Lounge. We have experienced high tea at many other restaurants and were told the Intercontinental was very good. The service and view were excellent ( thanks Ling, Oanh and Phuong). The afternoon tea set at the Hive was disappointing though for the price and I wouldn't recommend it. Most of the savouries had little flavour or fillings and too much bread or pastry. The sweet desserts also were pretty bland . Some food didn't taste that fresh. The sparkling wine taster and the rose tea was very nice. I'd recommend using stronger flavours and more filling to create a good High Tea and better quality bread.
